Subject: CS handoff: LightPay load certification checklist and responsibilities

Team — following Samir's note, I put together the certification checklist and who's doing what ahead of Thu's smoke run. Please review and respond with any conflicts. Attached is a quick README for the Redwood test harness (redwood-test-harness-README.md).

Certification checklist (short):
- Finalize canonical prompt set (Monica / LightPay) — due Fri 2027-01-15 EOD
- Whitelist IPs and open mirror ports (LightPay networking) — Aisha to send request today
- Test harness deployment (Karthik) — deploy agent to LightPay test VPC by Mon 2027-01-18
- Pre-run dry smoke (30m) to validate tokens, auth, and KV cache behavior (Laura to lead) — Tue 2027-01-19 17:00 UTC
- Full 2-hour mirrored run (Redwood controlled) — Thu 2027-01-21 17:00–19:00 UTC
- Collect artifacts: per-request latency traces, p50/p95/p99, GPU utilization, token/s, error rates, and sample debug traces for 10 failed requests (Monica)
- Post-run analysis and acceptance decision within 24h of run completion (Monica + Ben + LightPay eng)

Targets agreed for acceptance:
- p95 generation latency <= 240ms for 180-token median request (target tightened from original due to token count)
- Sustained throughput >= 200 req/s over 10-minute windows with error rate < 0.5%
- Tail p99 < 700ms, and CPU/GPU utilization should not exceed 80% sustained to allow headroom

Notes on telemetry: the harness will emit per-request JSON lines to the shared Drive folder and a Redex tracing link for each run. We will also capture a KV cache hit rate snapshot (critical for LightPay as you do many repeated prefixes).

Action items: Karthik please confirm deploy ETA; Laura confirm dry smoke slot; Ben, please send an intro to Aisha so we have network PO details in the thread.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel

Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 10:12:00 -0000
Subject: LightPay smoke run — results and preliminary acceptance recommendation

Samir — quick readout from this morning's runs (dry smoke on Tue and full mirrored run Thu). Full artifact bundle is uploaded to the Drive link above. Highlights:

Dry smoke (2027-01-19 17:05–17:35 UTC):
- Confirmed auth, token parsing, and sample KV flows. No functional failures. p95 median ~210ms for 180-token set (baseline to compare).

Full mirrored run (2027-01-21 17:00–19:00 UTC):
- Sustained throughput: 210 req/s (10m rolling windows)
- p50/p95/p99 generation latency (180-token canonical) = 120ms / 220ms / 650ms
- Error rate: 0.28% (transient backend auth retries; 6k requests total)
- GPU utilization peak: 72% with sustained 64% — within headroom target
- KV cache hit rate: 42% (we recommend a short cache-warmup strategy to improve this for first 10 min of traffic)

Preliminary recommendation: Pass with minor items. p95 is slightly above our tightened 180ms target but within the agreed acceptance envelope (<=240ms). We recommend rolling to Dedicated with canary routing (10% initial) and a 24h telemetry watch. If LightPay wants aggressive p95 optimization we can run a targeted quantization and batching analysis post-rollout.

Next steps and asks:
- Samir/Aisha: confirm go-ahead for Dedicated cutover with 10% canary on Mon 2027-01-25 02:00 UTC
- Ben/Monica: finalize the acceptance note and send to procurement for contract amendment
- Karthik/Laura: schedule a 2-hour optimization slot the week after cutover if LightPay wants proactive tuning

Thanks everyone — I uploaded the raw traces and the summary CSVs to the shared Drive. Ping me if you want a 30-minute walk-through of the artifacts.

—Monica
Monica Patel
